name: @yottameta/yotta-prompt
description: YuanYin — an intent-clarification & ecosystem-entry skill for AI agents: when a user types a vague phrase or a single word, it identifies the intent, offers 2-4 candidate directions, deep-dives into goal/scope/output, then routes to the matching YottaMeta skill and outputs a ready-to-run prompt. Always-load (session-start) entry-layer skill that catches users who do not know how to prompt AI. Boundaries: clarification only, no preset stance, no safety review; no artificial limits on prompts (must not violate laws / jailbreak); not a prompt beautifier; fully local and offline (Python 3.8+ standard library).
